note: Every fixing withdrawn after publication. A withdrawn fixing stays in the archive and the history as published, but it is not a valid reading. asOf is the date of the latest fixing this list was built with: a fixing dated after asOf has not been checked yet.

withdrawals.reason: Published in error. Zest's data contract returned a borrow rate of 0.01% on a market holding $53M, which is the venue not reporting rather than a real rate. Methodology 1.1.0 adds a plausibility floor so a funded market reading below 0.05% on both sides is excluded rather than published. The figure originally published is retained above so the record is complete.
